title: Act: Implement lifecycle Create/Open/Close, snapshot and Git head
summary: Add Service, snapshot writer, gitrepo.Head and store frozen guard
description: Add round.Service with Create, Open, Close, Get; snapshot.go writing snapshot.yaml; gitrepo.Head via rev-parse; contribution FileStore.ListByRound and ErrFrozen guard.
acceptance_criteria: Create assigns Number max+1 and ID ROUND-%07d and rejects when a non-terminal round exists with ErrActiveRound
Close order: write snapshot, commit, Head, set freeze_commit and CLOSED, save, commit round.yaml
Save in FileStore returns ErrFrozen when snapshot.yaml exists
technical_constraints: Service fields: Store *FileStore, Git GitRevisioner{Committer; Head(ctx)(string,error)}, Contributions interface ListByRound, Now func() time.Time, DefaultDuration, DefaultBaseRelease

steps.action: Add interface Revisioner{Head(ctx context.Context)(string,error)} and method (c *CLI) Head that runs `rev-parse HEAD` through c.Run (defaulting to defaultRunner) in c.Dir and returns strings.TrimSpace of output, wrapping errors with commandError("rev-parse",...)

Add ErrFrozen var; add ListByRound(ctx, worldID, roundID) globbing worlds/<world>/rounds/<round>/contributions/*.md via readFile sorted by CreatedAt then ID; in Save, after taking s.mu.Lock and before os.OpenFile, stat filepath.Join(s.Root,"worlds",c.WorldID,"rounds",strings.ToLower(c.RoundID),"snapshot.yaml") and return ErrFrozen when it exists
steps.expected: Save into a frozen round returns ErrFrozen

steps.action: Define Snapshot{Round,World string; FrozenAt time.Time; Contributions []SnapshotEntry{ID,Player string; CreatedAt time.Time; PromptSHA256 string}} with yaml tags; writeSnapshot(dir,s) marshals and creates snapshot.yaml with os.OpenFile O_CREATE|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY mode 0o444, returning ErrSnapshotExists if present
steps.expected: Second write to same dir fails

steps.symbol: new: Service, Create, Open, Close, Get, ErrActiveRound
steps.action: Implement Service guarded by sync.Mutex. Create(ctx,worldID,startsAt,duration,baseRelease) builds the next Round in SCHEDULED, rejects when any round is not COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED, saves, commits round.yaml. Open(ctx,worldID,roundID,opts) calls Transition(StatusOpen), sets StartsAt=Now(), EndsAt=StartsAt+duration (opts.Duration or DefaultDuration), BaseRelease (opts or default), saves and commits. Close(ctx,worldID,roundID) checks CanTransition(OPEN,CLOSED) first, lists contributions, writeSnapshot, commits snapshot.yaml, calls Git.Head, sets FreezeCommit, ClosedAt, Transition(CLOSED), saves and commits round.yaml
steps.expected: Rounds open and close with frozen snapshot
